purpose: Modern Age transparent cardinal trenches and independent gun nests

sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production painted component for a modular top-down Modern Age RTS trench and gun-nest kit. Match the reference game's polished, crisp hand-painted material finish, muted khaki and earth palette, strong readable silhouettes at 24–32 pixels per cell. Reference images are STYLE and footprint references only; do not recreate their buildings or medieval masonry. Camera strictly vertical overhead, orthographic nadir plan, no isometric tilt, horizon or upright elevation. No people, labels, text, UI, flags, watermark or long cast shadows. Create one square, full-canvas seamless-style hand-painted material patch of compact brown excavated earth for the shoulders and dark floor of military trenches. Packed fine soil, small irregular lumps and restrained subtle gray-brown stones, warm desaturated brown. Even overhead soft diffuse light, consistent density across all edges. No grass, crater, ditch, objects, construction, framing or vignetting. This is an evenly lit flat material swatch, no perspective, fully opaque across the entire square.
